title: flybot/01/sensors
description: Robot sensor readings, 10-20 Hz, QoS 0, not retained. Contract section 3.1.

bid.description: Boot ID: random per robot boot; a different bid means the robot rebooted (contract 2, 6 rule 4).

ol.description: Left odour, change from baseline scaled 0-1 (3 dp). null while warming up.

or.description: Right odour, change from baseline scaled 0-1 (3 dp). null while warming up.

d.description: Ultrasonic distance, cm (1 dp). null = no valid echo.

lt.description: Light level 0 dark - 1 bright (2 dp). null if no LDR fitted.
